page.layout: One printed page, numbered 121. Top: running head "VARIA POEMATA." with page number at the upper right. Below the head: two lines of verse (a closing poem of the previous piece) at full width. Then a centred heading in capitals with a subtitle in roman type, followed by a verse poem of text in one block, with a larger initial Q. No margin notes; no notes below the text.

main_text.p:
Hæc triplex virtus terreni Numinis orbem
Concutit, & pasfim bella cruenta mouet.
main_text.head: REMEDIVM PRÆSENS, quo Xiftus Pontifex omnem animi ægritudinem pellere solet.
main_text.p:
QVVM sibi Gallorum metuens rex prouidus ambos Guifiadas iuftis perdidit infidiis:
Ilicet Italicas fama properante pervrbes Audiit hoc Xiftus præsul & obstupuit.
Sæpius atque imo ducens suspiria corde, Attonito tales reddidit ore sonos.
Heu heu nunc noftræ periit spes vltima Romæ,
Nunc, nunc Pontificum nomen inane iacet.
Quis posthac metuet violato iure furores
Et Capitolini fulmina vana Iouis?
Ipse pias Rex est ausus contingere vittas,
Romuliduomque simul vertere iura Patrum.
Non tua te pietas, Ludouice, nec infula texit
Nec praetenta sacræ purpura sacra togæ,
Non tua te virtus, heros fortissime, texit,
Henrice, aut noftræ Religionis amor.
Fleret adhuc Summus tam tristia funera præsul,
Sed petiit vinum, largius atque bibit.

page.notes:
Printed text is set in roman with italic verse lines; the text is set as verse lines, so "
" separates verse lines within one stanza-paragraph. Some letters are worn and doubtful in the first lines ("Guifiadas" for Guisiadas; "Romuliduomque" appears to read "Romulidumque" with a worn letter). The large initial Q of "QVVM" is a woodcut-style initial. Word "Summus" and "Heu" are printed as read. Lines at "Ipse pias Rex est ausus contingere vittas" and "Romuliduomque" are doubtful; the scan is faint at those points. A faint mark at the bottom centre is not printed text and is omitted.
